##### Project general facts

One Peninsula by Holm Developments is a premium waterfront development designed around the concept of elevated coastal living. Set in a prime waterfront location, the project offers residents a unique combination of contemporary architecture, panoramic views, and a thoughtfully curated lifestyle. The development is positioned to provide a sense of tranquility while remaining well connected to the city and its key destinations.

The project features a collection of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom residences, designed to maximize comfort and take full advantage of the surrounding waterfront views. One Peninsula places a strong emphasis on lifestyle, offering an impressive selection of amenities including swimming pools, a lap pool, padel court, BBQ areas, outdoor lounges, a games room, kids’ play area, cafés and restaurants, a business and meeting lounge, and a residents’ cinema. Together, these spaces create a vibrant environment where residents can enjoy relaxation, recreation, wellness, and social experiences within the development.

The residences are designed with a contemporary aesthetic and a focus on comfortable modern living. Apartments come fully furnished and equipped, providing a convenient turnkey experience for owners and residents. One Peninsula offers an attractive opportunity for those looking to combine waterfront living with modern amenities, convenience, and long-term value.

##### Location description and benefits

Batumi is one of the most attractive destinations on Georgia’s Black Sea coast, located in the beautiful Adjara region at the foot of the Caucasus Mountains. One of its key advantages is the unique combination of sea, mountains, and a mild subtropical climate, creating an exceptional environment for both leisure and year-round living. The city is surrounded by lush greenery and spectacular natural landscapes, while the Black Sea coastline offers opportunities for beach activities, relaxation, and outdoor recreation.

Batumi also stands out for its well-developed tourism and urban infrastructure. The city offers a long seaside boulevard, beaches, modern hotels, restaurants and cafés, entertainment venues, a vibrant nightlife, and a charming historic center combined with striking contemporary architecture. Batumi is also becoming increasingly attractive for long-term residents and remote professionals, with coworking spaces, international services, and a growing expat community. Its rich gastronomy, famous Georgian and Adjara cuisine, local wines, and diverse dining scene add another important lifestyle advantage.

From a connectivity and investment perspective, Batumi has a highly strategic location and excellent accessibility. Batumi International Airport is located just a few kilometers from the city, providing convenient connections with international destinations, while the proximity to Turkey and the city’s role as an important regional transport and port hub further strengthen its position. Overall, Batumi offers a rare combination of coastal lifestyle, spectacular nature, modern infrastructure, international accessibility, tourism potential, vibrant urban life, and attractive opportunities for business and investment, making it one of the most promising locations in the region.
